contract.funding_scope: observed end-to-end monthly appropriation changes, not a private AI command trace
contract.pre_state_scope: start of monthly tick; economy/drift may change before the coup is settled
contract.proxy_scope: national mass accounting with exact frozen20 civilian_public_mandate function reproduced, including attested opening mandate; raw source copied and hashed

limitations: Pre-coup state is immediately before the entire monthly tick, not an instrumented internal government-event instant.
Military-share increases are actual observed game state changes with zero submitted external commands; this diagnostic does not intercept private SetMilSpend calls.
Public-consent proxy reproduces current national-share and eligibility accounting for diagnosis; it is not a new historical-mandate claim.
Population represents game GDP-per-head context; low income alone is not a coup cause.
